# nomatron_speculative_plan (Action)

Trigger a speculative plan for an existing Nomatron job.

## Example Usage

```terraform
action "nomatron_speculative_plan" "example" {
  config {
    org_name = "platform"
    app_slug = "payments"
    job_slug = "web"
    ref      = "feature/my-branch"
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_slug` (String) Application slug that owns the job.
- `job_slug` (String) Nomatron job slug to plan.
- `org_name` (String) Organization name that owns the application.

### Optional

- `ref` (String) Optional git ref override for the speculative plan.
